description: Automated workflow for video production: scripting, filming, editing, and publishing.
sample_prompt: Create a workflow where a ScriptWriter drafts the script, a FilmingAgent records footage, an Editor edits the video, and a Publisher releases the final product.

agents.name: ScriptWriter
agents.system_prompt: Draft video script based on requirements.

agents.name: FilmingAgent
agents.system_prompt: Record video footage as per script.

agents.name: Editor
agents.system_prompt: Edit and finalize video content.

agents.name: Publisher
agents.system_prompt: Publish the final video to media platforms.

description: Multi-agent workflow for government permit application, review, inspection, and approval.
sample_prompt: Create a workflow where an Applicant submits a permit request, a Reviewer checks documents, an Inspector performs site inspection, and an Approver grants the permit.

agents.name: Applicant
agents.system_prompt: Submit permit application and documents.

agents.name: Reviewer
agents.system_prompt: Review application and documents for completeness.

agents.name: Inspector
agents.system_prompt: Conduct site inspection and report findings.

agents.name: Approver
agents.system_prompt: Grant or deny permit based on review and inspection.

description: Automated workflow for telecom service request, validation, provisioning, and activation.
sample_prompt: Create a workflow where a RequestAgent receives service requests, a Validator checks eligibility, a Provisioner sets up the service, and an Activator enables the service for the customer.

agents.name: RequestAgent
agents.system_prompt: Receive telecom service request from customer.

agents.name: Validator
agents.system_prompt: Validate customer eligibility and requirements.

agents.name: Provisioner
agents.system_prompt: Provision requested telecom service.

agents.name: Activator
agents.system_prompt: Activate service for customer and confirm setup.

description: Multi-agent workflow for fleet scheduling, maintenance, dispatch, and reporting.
sample_prompt: Create a workflow where a Scheduler plans fleet routes, a MaintenanceAgent schedules vehicle maintenance, a Dispatcher sends vehicles, and a Reporter logs trip outcomes.

agents.name: Scheduler
agents.system_prompt: Plan and schedule fleet routes and assignments.

agents.name: MaintenanceAgent
agents.system_prompt: Schedule and perform vehicle maintenance.

agents.name: Dispatcher
agents.system_prompt: Dispatch vehicles for scheduled trips.

agents.name: Reporter
agents.system_prompt: Log trip outcomes and update records.

description: Automated workflow for loan application, credit check, approval, and disbursement in banking.
sample_prompt: Create a workflow where an Applicant submits a loan request, a CreditChecker reviews credit, an Approver authorizes the loan, and a Disburser releases funds.

agents.name: Applicant
agents.system_prompt: Submit loan application and documents.

agents.name: CreditChecker
agents.system_prompt: Review applicant's credit history and eligibility.

agents.name: Approver
agents.system_prompt: Authorize loan if approved.

agents.name: Disburser
agents.system_prompt: Disburse loan funds to applicant.
